title: 第一卷 第25章 做个不起眼的普通人第一卷 第26章 与丹阁的合作事宜
content_zh:
炼丹过程是枯燥且乏味的。
不仅要调整火候和包裹药材的灵气浓度，还要时时刻刻盯着炉孔，观察在火焰中翻腾的灵药变化。
时间长了难免被高温炙烤，导致双目发酸发痛。
长此以往，成不成得了丹道高人先不说，总觉会先炼成火眼金睛……
而且九阳真火消耗法力极大，先前炼制辟谷丹时并未察觉，毕竟辟谷丹使用的灵药都很容易炼化。
可真开始炼制聚灵丹，才发现完全不是那回事。
光是第一步融材就花费将近半个时辰，照这个速度下去，半天时间能出一颗聚灵丹就不错了。
怪不得说这些高质丹药难炼。
难的地方不在步骤，而在过程。
时间一长整个过程就会格外熬人，而且还需聚精会神，稍不注意火候一大，灵草内蕴含的灵力支撑不住，就会直接产生灵爆。
火候一小又容易导致后续提炼环节出问题，需逐渐提升火候。
温度高了就极难控制，稍不注意就是‘嘣’！
有了前几次炸炉的经验，陈玄炼丹手法已不再生涩，炼制聚灵丹时也游刃有余，倒是不担心会炸炉。
唯一需要注意的就是法力消耗。
按第一步的时间来算，后续提炼过程也不会轻松，估计最多三转也就到头了。
时间一点点流逝。
当太阳斜挂在山头，余晖洒满荒村内。
终于，陈玄长舒口气，展开左手，右手用法力牵引，裹挟一颗绿油油的丹药从丹炉飞出，落在左手手心。
“成功了！”
陈玄疲倦的脸上带着少许欣喜，第一颗聚灵丹就这样炼成。

虽炼制过程实属不易，但也算是得心应手，不像第一次炼丹那般手忙脚乱。
一颗聚灵丹炼制足足花费一下午的光阴。
“这样不行，下次尝试两三颗一起炼制。”
与掌柜定好的时间是半月，照这个进度，不修行光炼丹一个月都悬，何况他还要练习‘塑骨化形术’。
收起丹炉，陈玄转身朝‘自己的’小院走去。
回屋坐在床上，先按照炼气法本的内容调息打坐补充法力，随后吐出一口浊气，从吊坠中取出一瓶金骨丹。
这种瘦长的瓶子一般都是五粒装，而那种矮胖的瓶子都是十粒装。
倒出一枚金骨丹放在手心，毫不犹豫打进嘴里。
温润的丹药顺着嗓子眼滑进腹部，顿时一股暖洋洋的气息传遍全身。
这种温和的感觉没持续多久，化作蛮横的药力在筋脉中横冲直撞，疼痛感霎时传遍周身。
现在陈玄已不同往日，筋脉经过几轮丹药开拓，这种程度的疼痛已微不足道。
而且他现在已是炼气中期，可以主动运转法力来炼化药力。
双手正对在腹部画圈，很快就引导药力在筋脉中洗练一周，最终归于丹田道根处，与火道根融为一体。
自上次‘误食’聚灵丹后，经过那一轮霸道药力的冲刷，筋脉已快达到炼气境的极限，肉身也强化不少。
那时他就觉得，或许磕药来修炼，并不比正常修行差多少，当然前提是服用洗经伐髓类的丹药。
那种吃了直接突破境界的，总归会为后续修行留下许多隐患。
content_en:
The process of alchemy is boring and tedious.
It is not only necessary to adjust the heat and the concentration of spiritual energy wrapping the medicinal materials, but also to keep an eye on the furnace hole to observe the changes in the elixir churning in the flames.
Over time, it will inevitably be burned by the high temperature, causing the eyes to become sore and painful.
If things go on like this, I won't say whether I will become a master of alchemy or not, but I feel that I will develop fiery eyes and golden eyes first...
Moreover, Nine Yang True Fire consumes a lot of mana, which was not noticed when refining Bigu Pill before. After all, the elixir used in Bigu Pill is easy to refine.
But when I really started refining the Spirit Gathering Pill, I realized that it was not the case at all.
The first step of blending materials alone takes nearly half an hour. At this rate, it will be good to produce a Spirit Gathering Pill in half a day.
No wonder these high-quality elixirs are difficult to refine.
The difficult part is not the steps, but the process.
As time goes by, the whole process will be extremely tiring, and it requires concentration. If you don't pay attention, if the heat is too high, the spiritual power contained in the spiritual grass will not be able to support it, and a spiritual explosion will occur directly.
A small heat can easily cause problems in the subsequent refining process, so the heat needs to be gradually increased.
When the temperature is high, it is extremely difficult to control. If you don’t pay attention, it will ‘boom’!
With the experience of exploding the furnace several times before, Chen Xuan's alchemy technique is no longer astringent, and he can refine the Spirit Gathering Pill with ease, so he is not worried about the furnace exploding.
The only thing to note is the mana cost.
Judging from the time of the first step, the subsequent refining process will not be easy. It is estimated that it will be over in three turns at most.
Time passes little by little.
When the sun hangs obliquely on the top of the mountain, the afterglow fills the deserted village.
Finally, Chen Xuan breathed a long sigh of relief, unfolded his left hand, and used his right hand to pull it with magical power. A green pill flew out of the pill furnace and landed in the palm of his left hand.
"Success!"
Chen Xuan's tired face showed a little joy, and the first spirit-gathering pill was made in this way.
Although the refining process was not easy, it was still quite easy and not as hectic as the first time he made the elixir.
It takes an entire afternoon to refine a single Spirit Gathering Pill.
"If this doesn't work, try to refine two or three together next time."
The time agreed upon with the shopkeeper was half a month. According to this progress, it would take him a month if he didn't practice Light Alchemy, not to mention that he also had to practice the 'Bone Shaping Technique'.
Putting away the alchemy furnace, Chen Xuan turned around and walked towards his 'own' courtyard.
He went back to the room and sat on the bed. He first adjusted his breath and meditated according to the Qi Refining Book to replenish his mana. Then he exhaled a breath of turbid air and took out a bottle of Golden Bone Pill from the pendant.
The slim and long bottles usually come in five-pack sizes, while the chunky bottles usually come in ten-pack sizes.
He poured out a Golden Bone Pill and put it in the palm of his hand, popping it into his mouth without hesitation.
The warm elixir slid down his throat and into his abdomen, and a warm breath suddenly spread throughout his body.
This gentle feeling didn't last long, and turned into a brutal force of medicine that rushed through the muscles and veins, causing pain to spread all over the body in an instant.
Chen Xuan is no longer the same as before. After several rounds of elixirs, his tendons and veins have been opened up, and the pain of this level is no longer insignificant.
Moreover, he is now in the middle stage of Qi refining and can actively use his magic power to refine medicine.
With both hands facing each other, draw circles on the abdomen, and soon the medicinal power will be guided to practice in the tendons for a week, and finally return to the root of Dantian, integrating with the root of fire.
Since the last time he 'accidentally ate' the Spirit-Gathering Pill, his muscles and veins have almost reached the limit of the Qi Refining Realm after that round of overbearing medicinal power, and his physical body has also strengthened a lot.
At that time, he felt that perhaps taking medicine to practice cultivation would not be much worse than normal practice. Of course, the premise was that he took pills that cleanse menstruation and cut marrow.
Those who directly break through the realm after eating it will always leave many hidden dangers for subsequent practice.
